accessibility.description: An asymmetric translucent four-sided fold floats in dark blue fog.
A ring, broken signal path, and sparse points occupy a layered abstract field.
The abstract field widens, bends its signal path, and introduces a violet echo.
The current field rotates, then recalls two prior abstract states in a loop.
